firms.purpose: Active wildfire/fire detections globally, sized by fire radiative power and colored by recency
firms.dataSent: Satellite source (VIIRS or MODIS), day range (1-3)
firms.dataReceived: CSV with lat, lon, date/time, confidence, satellite, fire radiative power (MW), temperature (K)

nifc-wfigs.purpose: Best-available current U.S. wildland-fire perimeters from WFIGS. Dynamic data are not legal documents and NIFC gives no warranty as to accuracy, reliability, or completeness.
nifc-wfigs.dataSent: Generalized bounding-box coordinates (west, south, east, north) and a zoom-derived simplification offset, sent server-side; no browser IP, identity, or exact device location is forwarded.
nifc-wfigs.dataReceived: GeoJSON with current wildfire perimeter polygons, incident name, reported area, containment, discovery/update times, state, and cause

effis.purpose: Satellite-derived weekly MODIS burned-area polygons for Europe, the Middle East, and North Africa; not an authoritative fire perimeter.
effis.dataSent: Generalized bounding-box coordinates (west, south, east, north), sent server-side; no browser IP, identity, or exact device location is forwarded.
effis.dataReceived: GeoJSON with satellite-derived burned-area Polygon/MultiPolygon geometry, area in hectares, dates, country/region/locality, and source class; it is not an authoritative perimeter

noaa-hms.purpose: Observed smoke plume polygons from NOAA's Hazard Mapping System (HMS), derived from satellite imagery; density is qualitative and not a measured smoke concentration.
noaa-hms.dataSent: Source and time selection only, sent server-side; no browser IP, identity, or exact device location is forwarded.
noaa-hms.dataReceived: GeoJSON with observed smoke plume Polygon/MultiPolygon geometry and FID, satellite, start/end time, and qualitative density attributes
